bridge-type.label: LOQED Account
bridge-type.description: Connects to the LOQED Integrations API and discovers the account's locks.

parameter.name: apiToken
parameter.label: Personal Access Token
parameter.description: Personal access token created on the LOQED integrations website.

parameter.name: refreshInterval
parameter.label: Refresh Interval
parameter.description: Interval in seconds at which lock data is refreshed.

bridge-type.label: LOQED Local Bridge
bridge-type.description: Connects directly to a LOQED Bridge on the local network and receives signed webhook updates.

parameter.name: host
parameter.label: Host
parameter.description: IP address, hostname, or base URL of the LOQED Bridge.

parameter.name: bridgeKey
parameter.label: Authentication Key
parameter.description: Base64 authentication key used to manage and verify bridge webhooks.

parameter.name: callbackBaseUrl
parameter.label: openHAB Callback Base URL
parameter.description: Optional override for the automatically detected openHAB URL, for example http://192.168.1.10:8080.

parameter.name: refreshInterval
parameter.label: Status Refresh Interval
parameter.description: Fallback status refresh interval. Normal state updates are delivered by webhook.

thing-type.label: LOQED Smart Lock
thing-type.description: A LOQED Touch or LOQED Pure smart lock.

parameter.name: lockId
parameter.label: Lock ID
parameter.description: Unique lock identifier assigned by LOQED.

parameter.name: keySecret
parameter.label: API Key Secret
parameter.description: Base64 key secret used to sign local commands. Required with a local bridge.

parameter.name: localKeyId
parameter.label: Local API Key ID
parameter.description: Numeric ID belonging to the local API key. Required with a local bridge.

channel-type.label: Lock
channel-type.description: Locks the door with ON and unlocks it to day lock with OFF.

channel-type.label: Bolt State
channel-type.description: Current bolt state. Send OPEN, DAY_LOCK, or NIGHT_LOCK to operate the lock.

channel-type.label: Open House Mode
channel-type.description: Indicates whether Open House (party) mode is enabled.

channel-type.label: Guest Access
channel-type.description: Indicates whether guest access mode is enabled.

channel-type.label: Twist Assist
channel-type.description: Indicates whether twist assist is enabled.

channel-type.label: Touch to Connect
channel-type.description: Indicates whether the 500 m geofence restriction for Touch to Open is removed.
